public_summary: The authoritative research repository remains private through September 2026 while an explicitly sanitized static replay viewer is published as portfolio evidence. The deployment mirror is public-only and is not represented as the preferred source for modification during this period.
open_substitute: The public mirror includes rendered success and degraded replays, machine-readable release metadata, exact source revision, per-file SHA-256 digests, licenses, limitations, and local static-host instructions. The preferred source is scheduled to become public by 2026-09-30.
